            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and
                last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first
                eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the normalized
                telephone followed by the last name.
              type: string
              example: NSW-3A7BD3E2
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned stable identifier shared by all owners of the
                same household (same last name and address).
              type: string
              example: 3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Server-derived key used to detect duplicate owners, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email omitted as empty when absent).
                Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal, so
                members of the same household with different telephones are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                and last name (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration business day at the moment it was created, otherwise
                false. Flags a potential bulk-signup surge before the hard daily limit.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: NSW-3A7BD3E2-M26
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Luhn check digit (0 to 9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: Derived membership level from 1 to 3. Starts at 1, plus 1
                when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:

              description: Derived locality (canonical region), the region component of the
                customer code identity (the region derived from the postcode), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the code carries no region.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be valid for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when omitted
            on creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied in
            ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and
                last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first
                eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest over the normalized
                telephone followed by the last name.
              type: string
              example: NSW-3A7BD3E2
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned stable identifier shared by all owners of the
                same household (same last name and address).
              type: string
              example: 3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Server-derived key used to detect duplicate owners, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email omitted as empty when absent).
                Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal, so
                members of the same household with different telephones are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                and last name (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration business day at the moment it was created, otherwise
                false. Flags a potential bulk-signup surge before the hard daily limit.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: NSW-3A7BD3E2-M26
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Luhn check digit (0 to 9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: Derived membership level from 1 to 3. Starts at 1, plus 1
                when an email is present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Derived locality (canonical region), the region component of the
                customer code identity (the region derived from the postcode), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the code carries no region.
              type: string
              example: NSW

## Summary

Implemented soft-duplicate flagging on `POST /api/owners`. When a new owner isn't a hard duplicate (already rejected by `EnsureUniqueIdentity`) but shares an existing owner's **lastName + postcode** with a **different telephone**, it's still created and flagged.

Changes, each kept to its single responsibility:

- **New pipeline step** `FlagPossibleDuplicate.java` — the only new logic. Mirrors the existing `CountNamesakes`/`AssignHouseholdId` pattern: mutates the built `Owner` in place, scanning `findAll()` (which, running before `SaveOwner`, sees only pre-existing owners). Sets `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf`, reusing `TelephoneNormalizer.toE164` for the telephone comparison rather than duplicating normalization.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the step in between `flagBulkSignup` and `save`, under the same `transaction` governance.
- **`Owner.java`** — two persisted columns (`possibleDuplicate`, `possibleDuplicateOf`) with getters/setters, alongside the other derived fields.
- **`openapi.yml`** — declared both as read-only derived fields on the `Owner` schema; MapStruct maps them by name into `OwnerDto`, so `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns them.
- **schema.sql** (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres) — added the two columns to the `owners` table so the `ddl-auto=none` test profile (hsqldb) has them.

The dedicated `AcceptanceTest.coreFlagsPossibleDuplicate` and the full suite are green.
